label: June 2026 Paper 2 — Sampling theory original questions

items.stem: Study the following statements regarding the Horvitz-Thompson estimator:  A. Horvitz-Thompson estimate is an ordered estimate  B. The unbiased estimate of the variance of the Horvitz-Thompson estimator (Z̄n ) does not reduce to zero when all Zi ’s are equal.  C. The unbiased estimate of the variance of the Horvitz-Thompson estimator (Z̄n ) may assume negative values for some samples.  D. Horvitz-Thompson estimator (Z̄n ) is a biased estimator.  Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
items.explanation: Official answer C — B and C only. Response sheet Q124; you marked D — wrong.
